description: This file defines an interface 'CustomerOptionSetDao' for data access operations related to CustomerOptionSet entities, including methods for retrieving customer option sets by various criteria.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDao
classes.description: An interface for CustomerOptionSet data access operations extending generic DAO, providing specific methods for querying customer option sets.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific merchant store and option ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists CustomerOptionSet entities for a given store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOptionSet entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific store and option value ID.
